Here’s a simple, balanced week you can run in 4‑week blocks. It keeps three bouldering days and two antagonist sessions, with one full rest day.

Weekly layout
- Monday: Antagonist A (45 min) + mobility
- Tuesday: Bouldering – Technique/Volume (60–90 min)
- Wednesday: Rest or light cardio (20–30 min) + mobility
- Thursday: Bouldering – Limit/Power (75–90 min)
- Friday: Antagonist B (30–45 min) + mobility
- Saturday: Bouldering – Power‑endurance/Comp style (60–75 min)
- Sunday: Full rest (easy walk and stretching)

Session details
- Bouldering warm-up (all climb days)
  - 8–10 min easy cardio and joint prep
  - Shoulder activation: band pull-aparts, scap push-ups, wall slides (2x12 each)
  - Easy circuits: 10–15 min of very easy problems to groove footwork and timing
- Tuesday: Technique/Volume
  - Mileage on easy–moderate problems; aim 40–60 total “easy” moves
  - Drills: silent feet, downclimb every problem, 3–5 second pauses on holds
  - Cool down: 2–3 very easy problems, forearm extensor work (see below), stretching
- Thursday: Limit/Power
  - 4–6 hard boulders (short, powerful), 3–5 quality attempts each, 3–5 min rest
  - Optional power drills: coordinated moves or doubles at near‑max effort
  - Stop before form breaks; cool down as above
- Saturday: Power‑endurance/Comp style
  - 4x4s: pick 4 moderate problems; climb all 4 back‑to‑back = 1 set; rest 3–4 min; do 3–4 sets
  - Or on‑the‑minute doubles for 10–12 min with moderate problems
  - Finish with easy movement and stretching

Antagonist A (push/shoulder health/core/forearms)
- Horizontal push: push-ups or incline DB press 3x8–12
- External rotation (band/cable) 3x12–15 + face pulls 3x12
- Wrist/finger extensors: rubber‑band finger opens 3x20 + reverse wrist curls 3x15
- Core anti‑extension: dead bug 3x8/side, side plank 2x30–45s/side
- Hip hinge/posterior chain: light RDL or hip bridge 3x8–10
- Mobility: pec doorway stretch, t‑spine openers, forearm flexor/extensor stretches

Antagonist B (vertical push/scap stability/elbow care/core/uni‑leg)
- Vertical push: pike push-ups or DB overhead press 3x6–8
- Scap/rotator cuff: Y‑T‑W raises 2x10 + serratus wall slides 3x12
- Elbow health: pronation/supination with a hammer 3x12/side + light triceps 2x12
- Core anti‑rotation: Pallof press 3x10/side + hollow hold 3x20–30s
- Single‑leg RDL or step‑downs 3x8/side
- Mobility as above

Progression and recovery
- Weeks 1–3: add a little (one extra set, or slightly harder problems); Week 4: deload by 20–30% volume or intensity.
- Keep at least 24 hours between hard bouldering and the next hard session.
- Pain rule: no sharp shoulder/elbow pain; reduce intensity if tweaks appear.

If you still have volleyball on weeknights and soccer on Sundays
- Make the game night your rest or Antagonist B day.
- Keep Saturday bouldering moderate before Sunday soccer, or swap Sat/Sun so Sunday is full rest.
- Ensure one full rest day each week.

Day 3 – Tempo mix (about 35–45 min)

- 5 min easy cool‑down
Tip: Alternate every 5–10 min between different pool movements to beat the monotony.

Optional Day 4 – Short bursts (about 30–35 min)
- 10 min easy
- 12 x 30 sec strong effort with 60 sec easy between
- 5 min easy cool‑down

Guidelines
